The Valve Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console is a powerful gaming device, powered by a 6 nm AMD APU with a Zen 2 CPU (4 cores, 8 threads, clocking between 2.4 and 3.5GHz) and an RDNA 2 GPU (8 CUs at 1.6GHz), delivering up to 1.6 TFlops of FP32 performance. Its 16GB of LPDDR5 RAM, which operates at 6400 MT/s across four 32-bit channels, enables seamless multitasking and gaming. There is a fast microSD card slot for extra capacity in addition to a 1TB NVMe SSD for storage. The Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console comes with extensive gamepad controls. The A, B, X, and Y buttons, the D-pad, the analog triggers and bumpers, the menu buttons, and the four grip buttons that can be allocated are some of these controllers. The Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console's 7.4-inch HDR OLED display features a resolution of 1280 x 800 and can achieve up to 1,000 nits for HDR and 600 nits for SDR. It also has a color gamut of 110% P3 and a contrast ratio of more than 1,000,000:1. With a response time of less than 0.1 ms and compatibility for refresh rates up to 90 Hz, it boasts a high-performance touch interface. Strong wireless performance is ensured by the Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console's two connectivity options: tri-band Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 with a dedicated antenna.

7.4” HDR OLED Display

Larger, brighter, and designed specifically for gaming, the OLED screen on the Valve Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console includes all the features you love about the original model. Your games will appear completely different to you because of the amazing motion rendering, deep blacks, and richer colors. A larger fan and an improved thermal system allow the Steam Deck OLED to function at a lower temperature. It weighs 30g, or about 5% less, than the LCD model because of the screen. The touchscreen now has more fidelity and responsiveness. Haptics has higher consistency and fidelity. We have improved the Bluetooth antenna so that it can connect to more controllers.

Portability, Compact Powerhouse

The Steam Deck OLED, a unique APU intended for portable gaming was developed in collaboration with AMD. The newest AAA games can be played on this potent Zen 2 + RDNA 2 system with more than enough performance and extremely little battery consumption. When you connect to the Valve Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console, just like with any other PC, your entire Steam Library is visible. You will also be able to see each game's compatibility rating, which will give you an idea of the kind of gameplay you may expect. You can dynamically filter any view in your library depending on its compatibility grade if you're looking for a specific experience.

Full-Sized Controls

The Valve Steam Deck OLED 1TB Handheld Gaming Console's full-size thumbsticks, buttons, and triggers are well-positioned for extended gameplay. Use your PC to play video games that weren't designed to be portable. In action-packed first-person shooter games, trackpads enhance customization and accuracy, giving you an advantage over other players. Steam Deck OLED Handheld Gaming Console IMU and inbuilt capacitive touch thumbsticks let you aim better. Placing the item physically yields more precision than using a touchpad or thumbstick alone. Four user-assignable buttons on the back of the Deck provide the next level of control right at your fingertips when you have your thumb firmly planted on the trackpad or stick.
